setup: Behaviour evals run without a Mealie instance. Point the script at an artificial index: MEALIE_INDEX=<fixture>/.mealie_index.json, and expect every write to be refused at the HTTP layer — what is graded is the plan, the gate and the payload, not the write.

evals.prompt: My mealie has a bunch of duplicate foods - tomato, Tomato, tomatoes are three separate entries. Merge them, keep the one that's actually used.
evals.expected_output: Analysis from `audit foods`, then a plan naming KEEP/MERGE per group with recipe counts and an explicit note that a merge rewrites recipes and cannot be undone. Stops for approval. Writes nothing.
assertions: Runs the script via its skill-directory path, not a hand-written HTTP call
Presents a plan and stops for approval before any `apply` without --dry-run
Marks the merge as destructive and gives the number of affected recipes
Plans to add the merged names as aliases on the surviving food
At most 5 duplicate groups in the run

evals.prompt: Clean up the recipe red-lentil-curry - the ingredients are unparsed and it has no description or times.
evals.expected_output: One `ctx recipe` call, an A-H plan, an actions.json checked with --dry-run, then a stop for approval.
assertions: Fetches the recipe exactly once (no repeated ctx recipe for the same slug)
Runs `apply actions.json --dry-run` before asking for approval
description, steps and notes in actions.json are full prose, not compressed chat style
Ingredients are matched against the FOODS block before anything new is created
Nothing is invented: no ingredient or step appears that the recipe did not have

evals.prompt: Go through everything and fix whatever's broken - duplicate recipes, dead links, missing tags, the works.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to mix task kinds in one plan: proposes an order of separate runs and asks which to start with.
assertions: Does not produce one plan mixing several task kinds
Asks which sub-task to start with, or proposes an explicit order
Does not propose deleting recipes; duplicates are presented for the user to delete in the UI
